title: Turn an agent’s unverified handoff into a device test plan
summary: Marcos Placona requires each iOS-game task to report verified commands and test counts, unchecked behavior, and human blockers. An iOS team can turn the unchecked section into its device test plan: he reports finding an offline paywall alert and a missing rating prompt in areas already flagged, while acknowledging he does not yet know how the agent chooses which device-only risks to list.
takeaway: Require all three handoff sections on every task and test the unverified flows on a phone; an agent’s risk list guides review but does not prove it is complete.
